decisions.reason: As a recent line extension in floor care that is publicly offered on the website and fits the firm's established accessories business, management is likely to keep it and explain any weak early sales as temporary.
This maintenance oil closely supports the installed base of wooden floors and the firm's care-system positioning, so sunk effort and visible commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although a care product is a relatively small extension and therefore easier to cut than a core floor line, it still reinforces the firm's established offer and is likely to be retained absent clear failure evidence.
The moisture-protection underlay complements the firm's flooring systems and technical guidance, and because it was already marketed publicly management would be inclined to persist with it.
This underlay foam is a supporting product within the firm's core installation system, so in a growing industry management is likely to continue it rather than admit an early reversal.

An oak parquet floor is closest to the firm's core business and likely involved the strongest operational and reputational commitment, making escalation of commitment especially likely and withdrawal least likely.
